title: Coverage report (v1)
description: Per-run facet coverage. Two jobs: report target-versus-observed per axis value (targets are scheduler HINTS, never acceptance gates), and publish the per-record reporting state and derived publication eligibility so a consumer never has to re-derive them — and so neither has to be persisted on the record itself.

thresholds_constant.description: True when min_relevance, min_quality and accept_composite were identical in every round — the property that makes 'coverage targets never change what is accepted' checkable rather than merely asserted.

records.description: Optional per-record projection, keyed by record_id. Present so a consumer can read the reporting state and eligibility directly instead of re-deriving them from topic, primary_category, case_facets and legacy provenance. This is a REPORT, not a record field: record.v1.json gains no eligibility property.

publication_eligible.description: Derived. True means FACETS do not withhold the record; rejection_reason, the run-level publication_eligible flag and link-check outcomes are separate gates that still apply.

withheld_reason.description: The reporting state that caused a gated record to be withheld. Withheld is NOT rejected: the record keeps its record_id, carries no rejection_reason, and stays auditable.

reporting_state.description: Five mutually exclusive, exhaustive states over applicable (record_type == 'full') records. Precedence, first match wins: unmapped_legacy_value, then not_enriched, then facet_complete, then facet_partial, then unresolved. unmapped_legacy_value ranks FIRST and is never folded into unresolved — a legacy value with no reviewed mapping is a fact a reviewer must act on.

applicable_full_records.description: Records with record_type == 'full'. cross_reference rows are excluded from every count here: a pointer is not an independent record and counting it would double-count the record it points at.

states.description: All five counted separately, always. They sum EXACTLY to applicable_full_records; weak facets are never invented to improve a number.

gated.description: true only for cases/domain-applications. Case Studies and Product Discovery are report-only in v1: their states are counted and reported but block neither migration nor publication.

counts_toward_gap.description: false for cross-industry and other-unclear: they are counted and reported, but never close or reduce the gap of any concrete value.
